# Pki

`c.Pki` calls the API's Pki group. The certificates of the fleet, and the
rotation of the controller's key and of the NATS server's certificate.

### List

```go
func (s *PkiService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
	params PkiListParams,
) (*Response[PKICertList], error)
```

List the certificates of the fleet.

Lists the certificates of the controller's host, the API's, the controller's
metrics and the NATS server's, and the certificates that each agent reports in
its registration, with their expiry. A certificate that a host has not made is
not made.

It sends `GET /api/pki/cert`, and needs the permission `pki:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

List the certificates of the fleet, `go run pki.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.List(ctx, client.PkiListParams{})
```

List the certificates of the fleet, with --hostname web-01,
`go run pki.go list-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.List(ctx, client.PkiListParams{Hostname: "web-01"})
```


Get one certificate of a host.

Reads one certificate of one host: the controller's host when the hostname is
empty, or the agent of the hostname.

It sends `GET /api/pki/cert/{name}`, and needs the permission `pki:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Get one certificate of a host, `go run pki.go get`:

```go

```

Get one certificate of a host, with --name agent-metrics --hostname web-01,
`go run pki.go get-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Get(ctx, "agent-metrics", client.PkiGetParams{Hostname: "web-01"})
```


Show the rotation of the controller's key.

Shows the key that the controller signs jobs with, and during a rotation the key
that it switches to, when it switches at the latest, and each admitted agent
that the switch waits for, with whether it has the next key.

It sends `GET /api/pki/key`, and needs the permission `pki:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Show the rotation of the controller's key, `go run pki.go rotation`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Rotation(ctx)
```

### Rotate

```go
func (s *PkiService) Rotate(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[PKIKeyRotation], error)
```

Rotate the controller's key.

Starts the rotation of the controller's key, with no new admission of the
agents. The controller makes the next key, and signs a record that gives it to
the agents with its current key. Each agent takes it at its next heartbeat. The
controller switches to the next key when each admitted agent that reported
within controller.pki.rotation_grace_period has it, or when the grace period
ends. An agent that does not have it then needs a new admission. A rotation in
progress is not started again.

It sends `POST /api/pki/key`, and needs the permission `pki:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Rotate the controller's key, `go run pki.go rotate`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Rotate(ctx)
```

It sends `GET /api/pki/nats`, and needs the permission `pki:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

### Natscertrotate

```go
func (s *PkiService) Natscertrotate(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[PKINATSCertRotation], error)
```

Rotate the NATS server's certificate.

Starts the rotation of the NATS server's self-signed certificate, which each
joined agent pins, with no restart and no new join. The controller makes the
next certificate beside the current one, and signs a record that gives both to
the agents. Each agent trusts the next one at its next heartbeat. The controller
renames it into place when each admitted agent that reported within
controller.pki.rotation_grace_period trusts it, or when the grace period ends,
and NATS serves it at its next handshake. A rotation in progress is not started
again. It runs on the controller's host, which must hold the NATS server's
certificate, and refuses a certificate of the operator's cert_file.

It sends `POST /api/pki/nats`, and needs the permission `pki:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Rotate the NATS server's certificate, `go run pki.go natscertrotate`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Natscertrotate(ctx)
```

### Tls

```go
func (s *PkiService) Tls(
	ctx context.Context,
	params PkiTlsParams,
) (*Response[PKITLSList], error)
```

List the TLS of each component.

Lists the TLS section of the controller, of the NATS server and of each agent:
the FIPS 140-3 mode, with each reason that the component is not approved as a
sentence; each certificate that it serves, from pki cert list, with its subject,
its issuer, its validity and the days that are left; each TLS listener, with its
lowest version, its suites and its groups, and whether FIPS 140-3 approves them;
and the Go version, the module and the algorithms of its crypto. A certificate
within 30 days of its end is soon, and one past its end is expired.

It sends `GET /api/pki/tls`, and needs the permission `pki:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

List the TLS of each component, `go run pki.go tls`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Tls(ctx, client.PkiTlsParams{Component: client.Component("nats")})
```

List the TLS of each component, with --hostname web-01, `go run pki.go tls-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Tls(ctx, client.PkiTlsParams{Hostname: "web-01"})
```

List the TLS of each component, with, `go run pki.go tls-3`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Tls(ctx, client.PkiTlsParams{})
```

### Tlsget

```go
func (s *PkiService) Tlsget(
	ctx context.Context,
	component Component,
	params PkiTlsgetParams,
) (*Response[PKITLSSection], error)
```

Get the TLS of one component.

Reads the TLS section of one component of one host in full: the controller or
the NATS server of the controller's host when the hostname is empty, or the
agent of the hostname. It has the reasons, each certificate, each listener and
each algorithm.

It sends `GET /api/pki/tls/{component}`, and needs the permission `pki:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Get the TLS of one component, `go run pki.go tlsget`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Tlsget(ctx, client.Component("agent"), client.PkiTlsgetParams{Hostname: "web-01"})
```

Get the TLS of one component, with --component controller,
`go run pki.go tlsget-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Pki.Tlsget(ctx, client.Component("controller"), client.PkiTlsgetParams{})
```

The fields of each type are the properties of its schema in the API's spec.

### Component

Only this component: controller, nats or agent.

A `string`, one of `controller`, `nats`, `agent`.

### CryptoAlgorithm

| Field       | Type     | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Algorithm` | `string` | The algorithm, with its key size or curve.                                                                                                           |
| `Approved`  | `bool`   | Whether FIPS 140-3 approves the algorithm.                                                                                                           |
| `Name`      | `string` | What the process uses it for.                                                                                                                        |
| `OnlyMode`  | `bool`   | Whether it works in FIPS 140-3 only mode. An approved algorithm can still fail there, when its code calls the module in a way that the mode refuses. |
| `Reason`    | `string` | Why it is not approved, or why it fails in FIPS 140-3 only mode.                                                                                     |

### CryptoListener

| Field        | Type       | Description                                                                                                                          |
| ------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Approved`   | `bool`     | Whether the listener negotiates only approved versions, suites and groups: true in FIPS 140-3 mode, where crypto/tls restricts them. |
| `Groups`     | `[]string` | The key exchange groups that the listener can negotiate: the configured ones, or those of crypto/tls for the process's mode.         |
| `MinVersion` | `string`   | The lowest TLS version that the listener accepts.                                                                                    |
| `Name`       | `string`   | The listener, such as api, nats or metrics.                                                                                          |
| `Suites`     | `[]string` | The cipher suites that the listener can negotiate: the configured ones, or those of crypto/tls for the process's mode.               |
| `Tls`        | `bool`     | Whether the listener serves TLS. A listener with no TLS has no other fields.                                                         |
